beats.spoken_text: So, there are two kinds of websites, a dynamic and a static. A dynamic site knows who you are and changes for you, like Amazon shopping cart, a train booking site or even your banking app, where you log in with your ID and it will show your balance because behind it there is a server and a database but a static site is like a brochure everyone sees the same page nothing is stored nobody locks in for a small hotel that is enough rooms rates and button to call a message so when I give AI studio no limits it built a dynamic site a full react app structured for logins databases and live
